title: Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia
subtitle: Intelligent Systems · Nintendo 3DS
summary: Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia is Intelligent Systems' Nintendo 3DS reconstruction of Fire Emblem Gaiden. Alm joins an army resisting the invasion of Zofia, while Celica travels in search of the missing goddess Mila. body: Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia is Intelligent Systems' Nintendo 3DS reconstruction of Fire Emblem Gaiden. Alm joins an army resisting the invasion of Zofia, while Celica travels in search of the missing goddess Mila. Their separate routes cross a continent whose political troubles are entangled with the powers its people worship. The player manages both groups, moving between tactical battles, settlements and dungeons. Familiar characters return with new writing, voices and illustrations, giving the earlier adventure a substantially expanded dramatic presentation.

The world map connects battles and other destinations, but entering a dungeon puts a character directly under the player's control. Corridors can be searched for items, and contact with an enemy begins a tactical encounter. Those expeditions introduce fatigue, making supplies and the condition of the group matter across several fights. Back on the grid, spells spend the caster's health and weapons can teach Combat Arts. An ability that wins the current exchange may therefore reduce what its user can safely risk next.

Mila's Turnwheel allows a limited number of actions to be rewound. A badly judged advance can be examined and changed without repeating the entire battle, making it easier to understand exactly where a plan failed. The feature sits alongside the choice between permanent losses and returning allies. Dungeons, distinct armies and equipment retain Gaiden's unusual place within Fire Emblem, while the Turnwheel supplies a new way to learn its dangers. Alm and Celica remain separate leaders whose parties must each find a workable route forward.
story_headings: Leave the battlefield and enter a dungeon
A chance to reconsider a move
